items.title: OPTI-AML: prospective comparison of 28 vs 14 days of venetoclax induction with azacitidine in older adults with AML
items.abstract: Prospective randomized phase 2 OPTI-AML trial (NCT03013998) comparing 28-day versus abbreviated 14-day venetoclax dosing with azacitidine for cycles 1-2 in genomically unselected older/unfit newly diagnosed AML, testing whether shorter venetoclax reduces prolonged cytopenias while preserving efficacy.

items.title: Regional practice differences significantly impact benefit from post-HCT gilteritinib for FLT3-ITD AML
items.abstract: Post-hoc analysis of the phase 3 BMT CTN 1506 (MORPHO) trial showing that the survival benefit of post-transplant gilteritinib maintenance in FLT3-ITD AML is concentrated in patients transplanted sooner after diagnosis and those with detectable pre-HCT FLT3-ITD MRD, explaining the North America versus Europe/Asia discrepancy.

items.title: Clinical and genomic convergence of high-risk CCUS and lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes/neoplasms
items.abstract: Prospective study of 409 patients with clonal cytopenia of undetermined significance (CCUS) and 241 with lower-risk MDS applying harmonized criteria and the CHRS/CCRS risk scores, showing high-risk CCUS behaves clinically and genomically like lower-risk MDS and may warrant trial enrollment.

items.title: Assessment of the IPSS-M in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
items.abstract: Multicenter retrospective study of 511 patients evaluating the molecular IPSS-M score in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, testing its prognostic utility across the myelodysplastic and myeloproliferative subsets of a disease that remains difficult to risk-stratify.

items.title: Real-world investigation of germline predisposition to myelodysplastic syndromes
items.abstract: Real-world evaluation of systematic germline follow-up in 716 unselected patients evaluated for MDS, using diagnostic targeted sequencing to flag high-VAF CEBPA, DDX41, ETV6, GATA2 and RUNX1 variants and defining the feasibility and clinical yield of germline testing in routine practice.

items.title: Targeting ACSF2 overcomes Ara-C resistance in acute myeloid leukemia via the cholesterol metabolism-ERK signaling axis
items.abstract: Preclinical work identifying ACSF2 as a metabolic determinant of cytarabine (Ara-C) resistance in AML; ACSF2 inhibition impairs cholesterol esterification, causing mitochondrial dysfunction and ERK suppression that restores Ara-C sensitivity in vitro and in vivo.

items.title: Adaptor-mediated rewiring of FLT3 signaling engages p38 MAPK to sustain gilteritinib resistance in AML
items.abstract: Kinome-wide CRISPR screen in gilteritinib-resistant FLT3-mutated AML identifying p38alpha (MAPK14) rather than ERK as a prominent driver of adaptive resistance, nominating p38 MAPK as a combination target to extend FLT3-inhibitor benefit.

items.title: Haematopoietic cell transplantation for relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma: an EBMT registry cohort of 19 498 patients
items.abstract: Retrospective EBMT Lymphoma Working Group registry study of 19,498 autologous and allogeneic transplants for relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma from 2010-2022, evaluating how novel agents, donor selection and GVHD prophylaxis have changed post-transplant outcomes.

items.title: Loss of systemic anti-viral immunity and LMP1-driven suppressive myeloid niches shape EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
items.abstract: Integrated functional T-cell profiling and high-dimensional spatial proteomics showing EBV-positive DLBCL arises from convergence of broad antiviral T-cell dysfunction and an LMP1-dependent, PD-L1+/IDO1+ macrophage-rich immunosuppressive microenvironment, not simply immunosenescence.

items.title: CircZBTB46, a promising therapeutic target in crizotinib-resistant ALK-positive T lymphomas
items.abstract: Preclinical study of ALK-positive anaplastic large-cell lymphoma showing the circular RNA circZBTB46, driven by the NPM1::ALK/STAT3 axis, sponges miR-25-3p to sustain PIP5K1C and drive crizotinib resistance; silencing it restores ALK-inhibitor sensitivity.

items.title: Targeting BCMA in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma in 1 to 3 prior lines of therapy
items.abstract: Practical review synthesizing the recent wave of phase 3 BCMA-directed CAR T-cell, bispecific-antibody and antibody-drug-conjugate data in early-relapse (1-3 prior lines) myeloma, comparing trial populations and framing treatment-selection and sequencing decisions.

items.title: Peripheral MRD activity assessment by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (GMMG-HD7)
items.abstract: Analysis of 3,301 serum samples from 617 patients in the phase 3 GMMG-HD7 trial establishing MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry as a minimally invasive, prognostic measurable-residual-disease tool that complements bone-marrow MRD and outperforms serum protein electrophoresis at low M-protein levels.

items.title: Lisocabtagene maraleucel combined with ibrutinib in R/R CLL or SLL: primary results from TRANSCEND CLL 004
items.abstract: Primary results of the liso-cel plus concurrent ibrutinib cohort of the phase 1/2 TRANSCEND CLL 004 study in relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL, reporting complete-response rates and safety for combining CD19 CAR T cells with continuous BTK inhibition.

items.title: Development and external validation of a transcriptome-based prediction model for treatment-free remission in CML
items.abstract: Development in the multicenter STIM2 trial (n=96) and external validation of a peripheral-blood transcriptome machine-learning model predicting 2-year treatment-free remission after tyrosine kinase inhibitor discontinuation in chronic myeloid leukemia, where ~50% of patients relapse.

items.title: Long-term outcomes of second allogeneic transplantation following CD7 CAR-T in T-cell ALL or lymphoma
items.abstract: Observational study reporting the efficacy and safety of CD7-directed CAR T-cell therapy followed by a second allogeneic transplant in patients with T-cell ALL/lymphoma who relapsed after a prior allo-HSCT, a setting with dismal prognosis and few options.

items.title: TA-TMA and GVHD are distinct consequences of endothelial injury: a MIDAS consortium study
items.abstract: Prospective MIDAS cohort of 368 adult allogeneic transplant recipients measuring endothelial-injury biomarkers before and after HCT, showing transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy and GVHD are distinct endothelial-injury consequences and that post-transplant cyclophosphamide reduces acute GVHD.

items.title: Characteristics of donor and recipient clonal hematopoiesis in nonmyeloablative transplant for sickle cell disease
items.abstract: Study characterizing donor- and recipient-derived clonal hematopoiesis in patients undergoing nonmyeloablative allogeneic transplant for sickle cell disease, addressing concern that curative cellular therapies could raise the risk of therapy-related MDS/AML.

items.title: Platelet-activating anti-platelet factor 4 disorders
items.abstract: Review of the platelet-activating anti-PF4 disorders spectrum, spanning classic heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, autoimmune and spontaneous HIT variants, and vaccine-induced immune thrombotic thrombocytopenia (VITT), detailing their distinct antibody behaviors and highly prothrombotic clinical features.

items.title: Successful gene therapy for transfusion-dependent alpha-thalassemia: a case report
items.abstract: First-in-human report of lentiviral vector-mediated alpha-globin gene therapy in a 14-year-old with transfusion-dependent HbH disease, using ex-vivo-modified autologous CD34+ cells after busulfan conditioning to restore alpha-globin and address a disorder lacking curative options.

items.title: Burden of immune thrombocytopenia: patient and physician perceptions from the I-WISh 2.0 survey
items.abstract: I-WISh 2.0 survey of 1,018 patients and 431 physicians across 15 countries quantifying the symptom and treatment burden of immune thrombocytopenia, finding roughly a third of patients report high impact on daily life and 54% on emotional wellbeing, with patient-physician perception gaps.

items.title: Intravesical cretostimogene grenadenorepvec oncolytic immunotherapy in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with carcinoma in situ (BOND-003 Cohort C)
items.abstract: Single-arm phase 3 BOND-003 Cohort C trial of the oncolytic immunotherapy cretostimogene grenadenorepvec in high-risk, BCG-unresponsive non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer with carcinoma in situ, offering a bladder-sparing option with a manageable adverse-event profile.

items.title: Postmastectomy chest wall radiotherapy for breast cancer (SUPREMO): 5-year quality-of-life results
items.abstract: Quality-of-life substudy of the randomized phase 3 SUPREMO trial reporting 5-year patient-reported outcomes of adjuvant chest wall radiotherapy in intermediate-risk breast cancer after mastectomy, complementing the neutral 10-year overall-survival primary result.

items.title: Guanylyl cyclase 2C-targeted CAR T-cell therapy in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer
items.abstract: Open-label phase 1 dose-escalation and expansion study of a CAR T-cell therapy targeting GUCY2C, an antigen expressed across colorectal cancer stages, evaluating safety and efficacy in heavily pretreated metastatic disease where later-line options are limited.

items.title: Teclistamab in multiple myeloma with one to three previous lines of therapy (MajesTEC-9)
items.abstract: Phase 3 MajesTEC-9 trial randomizing 593 patients with relapsed/refractory myeloma after 1-3 prior lines to the BCMAxCD3 bispecific teclistamab versus PVd or Kd; teclistamab significantly improved progression-free (18-month 69.8% vs 26.9%) and overall survival, moving bispecifics into earlier relapse despite grade 3/4 infections in 41.6%.
